series.name: SIMREX hybrid 6KW-48V / PV-7000 Twin
series.notes: Official SIMREX manual: warning + fault + parallel + BMS tables. Numeric warnings W-prefixed; BMS 60/71 BMS-prefixed on collision.

meaning.en: Cooling fan not turning (fault).
meaning.ur: Pankha ghoom nahin raha (kharabi)

causes.en: Fan seized, foreign object, failed fan
causes.ur: Pankha atka / kharab

causes.en: Fan connector loose or supply wire broken.
causes.ur: Fan ka connection dheela ya supply wire tooti hui hai.

causes.en: Main board fan driver circuit failed.
causes.ur: Main board ka fan driver circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch off AC input and PV, open the DC breaker and wait 5 minutes; open the cover and look for dust or an object blocking the fan.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band karein, DC breaker kholein aur 5 minute intezar karein; cover khol kar dekhein ke dhool ya koi cheez pankha rok rahi hai.

solutions.en: With power isolated, spin the fan by hand — it must turn freely; check the fan plug on the board for a loose fit or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Power band hone ke baad pankha haath se ghuma kar dekhein — azaadi se ghumna chahiye; board par fan ka plug dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: If the fan is stuck or does not run, replace it with the same size fan and restart the unit to retest.
solutions.ur: Agar pankha phans gaya hai ya chal nahin raha, to usi size ka naya fan lagayein aur unit restart kar ke dobara test karein.

notes.en: SIMRON fault 01 text: Fan is locked when inverter is off.
notes.ur: SIMRON fault 01 ka text: jab inverter off ho tab fan locked hai.

meaning.en: Inverter component temperature over 100C.
meaning.ur: Inverter component ki temperature 100C se zyada hai.

causes.en: Blocked airflow, ambient too high, dirty filters
causes.ur: Hawa ka rasta band, mahol ki temperature zyada, filters gande.

causes.en: Cooling fan not running or running too slow.
causes.ur: Cooling fan chal nahin raha ya bohat dheere chal raha hai.

causes.en: Temperature sensor (NTC) reading wrong.
causes.ur: Temperature sensor (NTC) ghalat reading de raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off AC input and PV and let the unit cool for 10–15 minutes; clear blocked vents and clean dust from filters and heat sinks.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band kar ke unit ko 10-15 minute thanda hone dein; band vents kholein aur filters aur heat sinks se dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Restart with a lighter load and listen that the cooling fan runs; also check the room ambient is not too hot.
solutions.ur: Halka load kar ke restart karein aur sun kar dekhein ke cooling fan chal raha hai; kamre ka temperature bhi zyada to nahin, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: If the trip returns with clear airflow, the fan or temperature sensor is faulty — have the board checked at the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Hawa saaf hone ke baad bhi trip wapas aaye, to pankha ya temperature sensor kharab hai — board ko repair centre se check karwayein.

meaning.en: Battery over-charged / voltage above safe limit.
meaning.ur: battery zyada charge / voltage had se zyada

causes.en: Wrong battery spec/quantity, charger fault, wrong settings
causes.ur: ghalat battery ya charger

causes.en: Charger full-charge voltage set higher than needed.
causes.ur: Charger ka full-charge voltage zaroorat se zyada set hai.

causes.en: Battery cell weak or internally shorted.
causes.ur: Battery cell kamzor ya andar se short hai.

solutions.en: Switch off AC input and PV, then measure the battery voltage with a meter and compare it with the battery specification.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band kar ke meter se battery voltage naapein aur battery specification se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the number of battery units and the charger full-charge setting; correct the setting or quantity if they are wrong.
solutions.ur: Battery units ki tadad aur charger ka full-charge setting check karein; setting ya tadad ghalat ho to theek karein.

solutions.en: If the voltage is still too high with correct settings, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Sahi settings ke baad bhi voltage zyada rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

meaning.en: AC output short circuit detected; unit stops output.
meaning.ur: AC output short circuit ho gaya, output band.

causes.en: Wiring fault, appliance short, abnormal load
causes.ur: wiring kharabi ya load short

causes.en: Damaged appliance creating the short on the output.
causes.ur: Kharab appliance output par short bana raha hai.

causes.en: Moisture or a loose joint in the output wiring.
causes.ur: Output wiring mein pani (moisture) ya dheela joint hai.

solutions.en: Stop the unit and isolate AC input and PV at once — never probe a short while the output is live.
solutions.ur: Unit rok dein aur foran AC input aur PV alag karein — output chalte hue short par kabhi probe na karein.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output wiring and each appliance for burn marks or wet joints; unplug the suspect load.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke output wiring aur har appliance check karein ke jale hue nishan ya geele joints to nahin; shak wala load plug se nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Repair the wiring or remove the faulty appliance, then restart; if the code returns, the output stage needs service.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek karein ya kharab appliance hatayein, phir restart karein; code wapas aaye to output stage ki service zaroori hai.

meaning.en: Output abnormal; troubleshooting: inverter voltage <190Vac or >260Vac.
meaning.ur: output voltage had se bahar (<190V ya >260V)

causes.en: Overload dragging voltage, internal output stage fault
causes.ur: load ya andaruni kharabi

causes.en: Heavy load dragging the output voltage out of the band.
causes.ur: Bhari load output voltage ko band se bahar kheench raha hai.

causes.en: Loose output terminal or a high-resistance joint.
causes.ur: Output terminal dheela hai ya joint par zyada resistance hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load and restart, then measure the AC output with a multimeter to see whether it stays in the 190–260Vac band.
solutions.ur: Load kam kar ke restart karein, phir multimeter se AC output naapein ke woh 190-260Vac band ke andar rahta hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output terminals and wiring for looseness or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Supply alag kar ke output terminals aur wiring check karein ke dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin.

solutions.en: If the output is still outside the band with a light load, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Halke load par bhi output band se bahar rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

notes.en: Conflicts with SIMRON fault 06 wording Output voltage is too high.
notes.ur: Isay SIMRON fault 06 ki wording 'Output voltage is too high' se conflict hai.

meaning.en: Overload at 110% and timer expired; inverter shut down.
meaning.ur: 110% par overload aur timer khatam; inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Load exceeds capacity for too long
causes.ur: Load capacity se zyada hai aur yeh haal der tak raha.

causes.en: Motor or pump drawing more than its rated current.
causes.ur: Motor ya pump apne rated current se zyada kha raha hai.

causes.en: Many appliances started at the same time.
causes.ur: Ek sath bohat sare appliances start ho gaye.

solutions.en: Switch off some equipment so the load drops below the inverter rating, then restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Kuch equipment band kar dein taake load inverter rating se neeche aa jaye, phir unit restart karein.

solutions.en: Check the load with a clamp meter if available — motors and pumps can draw more than their rated current.
solutions.ur: Agar clamp meter ho to load check karein — motors aur pump apne rated current se zyada kha sakte hain.

solutions.en: Restart only after reducing the load; if it trips again, spread the load or have the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Load kam karne ke baad hi restart karein; phir trip ho to load baant dein ya unit check karwayein.

meaning.en: DC bus over-voltage.
meaning.ur: DC bus par voltage zyada.

causes.en: Internal power-stage issue, regenerative surge
causes.ur: andaruni power stage

causes.en: Load dump or regenerative energy raising the DC bus.
causes.ur: Load dump ya regenerative energy DC bus ko barha raha hai.

causes.en: DC bus capacitor or bleed resistor failed.
causes.ur: DC bus capacitor ya bleed resistor kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power off, switch off AC input and PV and wait 5 minutes; do not probe the DC bus — capacitors hold dangerous voltage.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, AC input aur PV off kar ke 5 minute intezar karein; DC bus par probe na rakhein — capacitors mein khatarnak voltage reh jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the cover with supply isolated and look for burnt parts, bulged capacitors or loose connections.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke cover kholein aur jalay hue parts, phoolay hue capacitors ya dheele connections dekhein.

solutions.en: If the fault repeats after restart, the power stage needs repair — send the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad bhi fault dobara aaye, to power stage ki repair zaroori hai — unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

notes.en: Troubleshooting groups 08/09/53/57 as Internal components failed.
notes.ur: Troubleshooting 08/09/53/57 ko 'Internal components failed' ke group mein rakhti hai.

meaning.en: DC bus soft-start sequence failed.
meaning.ur: DC bus ka soft-start sequence mukammal nahin hua.

causes.en: Internal components failed
causes.ur: andaruni kharabi

causes.en: DC bus did not charge during the soft-start.
causes.ur: Soft-start ke dauran DC bus charge nahin hua.

causes.en: Soft-start relay or resistor circuit fault.
causes.ur: Soft-start relay ya resistor circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, wait 5 minutes, then restart once and watch whether the code returns.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute ruk kar ek baar restart karein aur dekhein ke code wapas aata hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: Check the DC input cable and main fuse for looseness or damage; do not probe the high-voltage bus yourself.
solutions.ur: DC input cable aur main fuse check karein ke dheela ya kharab to nahin; high-voltage bus par khud probe na karein.

solutions.en: If the soft-start fails again, the DC/DC or bus stage has failed — send the unit for board repair.
solutions.ur: Agar soft-start phir bhi fail ho, to DC/DC ya bus stage kharab ho gaya hai — unit ko board repair ke liye bhej dein.

meaning.en: PV input current over limit (fault table). Troubleshooting maps fault 10 to Surge.
meaning.ur: PV input current had se zyada (fault table). Troubleshooting mein fault 10 ko Surge likha gaya hai.

causes.en: PV array oversized, surge on DC side
causes.ur: PV array bara aur DC side par surge.

causes.en: Parallel strings more than the unit input rating.
causes.ur: Parallel strings unit input rating se zyada hain.

causes.en: Lightning or switching surge on the DC side.
causes.ur: DC side par lightning ya switching surge aaya.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV DC isolator and check the array strings for damaged panels, water or loose connectors.
solutions.ur: PV DC isolator band kar ke array strings check karein ke panels kharab, paani ya connectors dheele to nahin.

solutions.en: Confirm the array is within the unit rating; reduce parallel strings if it is oversized, then restart.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke array unit rating ke andar hai; zyada bada ho to parallel strings kam kar ke restart karein.

solutions.en: If the fault returns with a correct array, have the DC input stage checked at the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Sahi array ke sath bhi fault wapas aaye, to DC input stage ko repair centre se check karwayein.

notes.en: Internal wording conflict: table PV current is over vs troubleshooting Surge.
notes.ur: Andar hi wording conflict hai: table mein 'PV current is over' vs troubleshooting mein 'Surge'.

meaning.en: Solar input voltage over limit (>500V per troubleshooting).
meaning.ur: solar input voltage had se zyada (>500V)

causes.en: Too many panels in series, wrong Voc
causes.ur: zyada panels series main

causes.en: Cold weather pushed the string Voc above 500V.
causes.ur: Sardi mein string ka Voc 500V se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Wrong array specification chosen for this model.
causes.ur: Is model ke liye ghalat array specification choose ki gayi.

solutions.en: Switch off the PV DC isolator before touching DC cables, then measure the string Voc with a meter.
solutions.ur: DC cable chhoone se pehle PV DC isolator band karein, phir meter se string ka Voc naapein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of panels in series until the voltage is within 500V, then reconnect and restart.
solutions.ur: Voltage 500V ke andar aane tak series mein panels ki tadad kam karein, phir connect kar ke restart karein.

solutions.en: Check for damaged panels or burning in the DC connectors; replace what is faulty before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Panels mein kharabi ya DC connectors mein jalan check karein; dobara power se pehle jo kharab ho use badal dein.

meaning.en: Charge current over limit (fault table). Troubleshooting: DC/DC over current or surge.
meaning.ur: Charge current had se zyada (fault table). Troubleshooting: DC/DC over current ya surge.

causes.en: PV/battery mismatch, DC/DC stage surge
causes.ur: PV/battery mismatch, DC/DC stage par surge.

causes.en: Battery bank smaller than the charge current needs.
causes.ur: Battery bank charge current ke mutabiq chhota hai.

causes.en: Loose DC connection causing current spikes.
causes.ur: Dheela DC connection current spikes la raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, then check the battery bank size and DC wiring — a small bank or loose link causes this.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke battery bank ki size aur DC wiring check karein — chhota bank ya dheela link yeh la sakta hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery and DC link voltage with a meter, reconnect and watch the charging current after restart.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery aur DC link voltage naapein, dobara connect kar ke restart ke baad charging current dekhein.

solutions.en: If the fault repeats with a correct battery and array, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Sahi battery aur array ke sath bhi fault dobara aaye, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

notes.en: Wording conflict table vs troubleshooting.
notes.ur: Table aur troubleshooting mein wording conflict hai.

meaning.en: Output/DC over-current or surge fault.
meaning.ur: Output/DC par over current ya surge.

causes.en: Motor/inrush load, short surge, internal fault
causes.ur: Motor/inrush jaisa load, short surge ya andaruni fault.

causes.en: Motor or pump inrush current at start-up.
causes.ur: Motor ya pump ka start par inrush current.

causes.en: Short or insulation fault on the output wiring.
causes.ur: Output wiring par short ya insulation fault.

solutions.en: Switch off heavy loads such as motors and pumps, restart the unit and see if it runs on a light load.
solutions.ur: Motor aur pump jaisi bhari load band kar dein, unit restart karein aur dekhein ke halke load par chal raha hai.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output and battery wiring for shorts, loose terminals or burnt cables.
solutions.ur: Supply band kar ke output aur battery wiring check karein ke short, dheele terminals ya jali hui cables to nahin.

solutions.en: If the error returns even on a light load, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Halke load par bhi error wapas aa jaye, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

meaning.en: DC bus under-voltage.
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage bohat kam.

causes.en: Weak battery, loose DC path
causes.ur: kamzor battery ya loose DC

causes.en: Battery discharged or one weak cell.
causes.ur: Battery discharge hai ya koi cell kamzor hai.

causes.en: Blown fuse or loose DC cable.
causes.ur: Fuse uda hua hai ya DC cable dheeli hai.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage under load with a multimeter — a weak battery is the usual cause.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se load par battery voltage naapein — kamzor battery aam wajah hoti hai.

solutions.en: Isolate supply and check DC cables, fuse and connections for looseness, corrosion or a blown fuse.
solutions.ur: Supply alag kar ke DC cables, fuse aur connections check karein ke dheela, zang ya uda hua fuse to nahin.

solutions.en: Charge or replace the battery and restart; if the trip repeats, send the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Battery charge ya replace kar ke restart karein; trip dobara aaye to unit ko repair centre bhej dein.

meaning.en: Inverter soft-start failed.
meaning.ur: Inverter soft start mukammal nahin hua

causes.en: Internal inverter stage fault
causes.ur: andaruni inverter kharabi

causes.en: DC bus did not reach the start level.
causes.ur: DC bus start level tak nahin pahuncha.

causes.en: Gate drive fault in the inverter stage.
causes.ur: Inverter stage mein gate drive fault hai.

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC input and PV and wait 5 minutes before opening the unit for a visual check.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute intezar karein, phir cover khol kar nazar se check karein.

solutions.en: Restart once after cooling; if the same code appears, the inverter stage failed to start.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad ek baar restart karein; agar wohi code aaya to inverter stage start nahin hua.

solutions.en: Do not keep cycling power — return the unit to the repair centre for board repair.
solutions.ur: Bar bar power on-off na karein — unit ko board repair ke liye repair centre le jayein.

title.en: Over DC offset in AC output
title.ur: AC output mein DC offset zyada

meaning.en: DC component on AC output (fault table). Troubleshooting: Output voltage is unbalanced.
meaning.ur: AC output par DC component (fault table). Troubleshooting: output voltage unbalanced hai.

causes.en: Output stage imbalance/fault
causes.ur: output stage kharabi

causes.en: One output leg or relay contact has high resistance.
causes.ur: Kisi ek output leg ya relay contact par zyada resistance hai.

causes.en: Output filter capacitor degraded.
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor kamzor ho gaya.

solutions.en: Reduce the load, restart and measure the AC output with a multimeter to confirm the DC component or unbalance.
solutions.ur: Load kam kar ke restart karein aur multimeter se AC output naapein ke DC component ya unbalance kitna hai.

solutions.en: With supply isolated, check the output wiring and relay contacts for looseness or burn marks.
solutions.ur: Supply alag kar ke output wiring aur relay contacts check karein ke dheela ya jale hue nishan to nahin.

solutions.en: If it stays abnormal even at no load, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Bina load ke bhi abnormal rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

notes.en: Wording differs table vs troubleshooting.
notes.ur: Table aur troubleshooting mein wording alag hai.

meaning.en: Current sensor failed.
meaning.ur: current sensor kharab

causes.en: Sensor/hardware failure
causes.ur: sensor kharabi

causes.en: Current sensor connector loose or damaged.
causes.ur: Current sensor ka connection dheela ya kharab hai.

causes.en: Main board sensing circuit fault.
causes.ur: Main board ki sensing circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, wait 5 minutes, then restart once to see whether the code clears.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke 5 minute ruk kar ek baar restart karein aur dekhein ke code hat jata hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: Open the unit with power isolated and check that the current sensor (CT/shunt) connector is seated and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Power band kar ke unit kholein aur check karein ke current sensor (CT/shunt) ka connector theek laga hai ya kharab to nahin.

solutions.en: The sensor or board circuit has failed — send the unit to the repair centre for replacement.
solutions.ur: Sensor ya board circuit kharab ho gaya hai — unit ko replacement ke liye repair centre bhej dein.

meaning.en: Output below acceptable range (grouped with fault 06 in troubleshooting: <190Vac or >260Vac).
meaning.ur: output voltage had se kam/zyada

causes.en: Heavy load, battery weak, output stage fault
causes.ur: zyada load ya kamzor battery

causes.en: Long output cable causing voltage drop.
causes.ur: Lambi output cable voltage drop de rahi hai.

causes.en: Weak battery under load.
causes.ur: Load par battery kamzor hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load and restart, then measure the AC output with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Load kam kar ke restart karein, phir multimeter se AC output naapein.

solutions.en: Check the battery voltage under load and the output wiring for loose joints — both pull the output down.
solutions.ur: Load par battery voltage aur output wiring ke dheele joints check karein — dono output ko neeche kheenchte hain.

solutions.en: If the voltage is still low, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage phir bhi kam rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

title.en: Battery not connected well / fuse burnt
title.ur: battery sahih munsalik nahin ya fuse jala gaya

meaning.en: Battery not connected well or fuse burnt (troubleshooting-only fault code; not in main fault table).
meaning.ur: Battery connection kharab ya fuse jal gaya

causes.en: Loose battery cable, blown fuse
causes.ur: Loose cable ya fuse

causes.en: Battery terminal corroded or clamp loose.
causes.ur: Battery terminal par zang hai ya clamp dheela hai.

causes.en: Main fuse blown after an over-current.
causes.ur: Over-current ke baad main fuse ud gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, then check the battery cables and terminals are tight and clean.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke battery cables aur terminals check karein ke tight aur saaf hain.

solutions.en: Check the main fuse with a meter for continuity and replace it if it is blown.
solutions.ur: Meter se main fuse ki continuity check karein aur uda hua ho to badal dein.

solutions.en: If the battery is connected well and the fuse is good but the code stays, return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Battery theek lagi hai aur fuse bhi theek hai phir bhi code rahe, to unit ko repair centre wapis le jayein.

notes.en: Appears only in troubleshooting table, not Faults Reference Code table.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf troubleshooting table mein hai, Faults Reference Code table mein nahin.

meaning.en: Current feedback into the inverter detected (parallel system).
meaning.ur: Inverter mein current ka feedback mil raha hai (parallel system).

causes.en: L/N reversed, sharing cable missing/wrong
causes.ur: L/N ulti, sharing cable ghalat ya mojood nahi.

causes.en: Parallel units wired on different phases.
causes.ur: Parallel units alag alag phases par lagi hain.

causes.en: Current-sharing cable loose or wrong type.
causes.ur: Current-sharing cable dheeli hai ya ghalat type ki hai.

solutions.en: Shut down the paralleled units and isolate AC input and PV — power feedback between units is dangerous until wiring is corrected.
solutions.ur: Parallel units band kar ke AC input aur PV alag karein — wiring theek hone tak units ke darmiyan power feedback khatarnak hai.

solutions.en: Check the parallel wiring, L/N phasing and current-sharing cables with a meter, and correct anything reversed or loose.
solutions.ur: Meter se parallel wiring, L/N phasing aur current-sharing cables check karein; jo ulta ya dheela ho use theek karein.

solutions.en: Do not re-energise until the installer has verified the wiring; contact the installer if the code remains.
solutions.ur: Installer ke wiring verify kiye baghair dobara power na dein; code bana rahe to installer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Dual meaning conflict with BMS code 60.
notes.ur: BMS code 60 ke sath is ki dual meaning conflict hai.

meaning.en: Parallel units on different firmware/CPU versions.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke firmware/CPU versions alag-alag hain.

causes.en: Mixed firmware across paralleled inverters
causes.ur: Paralleled inverters mein alag-alag firmware

causes.en: One unit upgraded while the others stayed on the old firmware.
causes.ur: Ek unit upgrade ho gayi, baqi purane firmware par reh gayin.

causes.en: Replacement board fitted with newer firmware.
causes.ur: Nayi board lagayi gayi jisme firmware naya hai.

solutions.en: Note the firmware/CPU version shown on each unit and compare them — all units must run the same version.
solutions.ur: Har unit par jo firmware/CPU version dikhaya gaya hai use note karein aur compare karein — sab units par wohi version hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Contact the installer for the correct firmware package and do not keep running mixed versions.
solutions.ur: Sahi firmware package ke liye installer se rabta karein aur mixed versions par chalte na rahen.

solutions.en: Upgrade all units to the same version and restart to confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Sab units ko ek hi version par upgrade kar ke restart karein aur code ke hatne ka tasdeeq karein.

notes.en: Dual meaning conflict with BMS code 71.
notes.ur: BMS code 71 ke sath is ki dual meaning conflict hai.

meaning.en: Output current of each parallel inverter different; often missing N bonds.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ka output current alag-alag hai; aksar N bonds mojood nahi hoti.

causes.en: Output N wires not commoned, sharing cable loose
causes.ur: Output N wires aapas mein juri hui nahi, sharing cable loose hai.

causes.en: Output N terminal not bonded on one unit.
causes.ur: Ek unit par output N terminal bonded nahin hai.

causes.en: Unequal sharing cable length or loose lug.
causes.ur: Sharing cable ki lambai alag hai ya lug dheela hai.

solutions.en: Shut down the units and isolate supplies before checking the parallel wiring.
solutions.ur: Parallel wiring check karne se pehle units band kar dein aur supplies alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check that all output N wires are commoned and the sharing cables are tight and equal.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sab output N wires common hain aur sharing cables tight aur barabar hain.

solutions.en: Balance the load, restart, and contact the installer if the code remains.
solutions.ur: Load balance kar ke restart karein, aur code bana rahe to installer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Manual warns twice: missing common N causes fault 72.
notes.ur: Manual do baar warning deta hai: common N na hone par fault 72 aata hai.

title.ur: CAN fault / CAN data ka gayab hona

meaning.en: CAN communication data loss between parallel units.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan CAN communication ka data kho gaya.

causes.en: Communication cable disconnected/damaged
causes.ur: communication cable

causes.en: CAN connector loose or a pin bent.
causes.ur: CAN connector dheela hai ya pin tedhi hai.

causes.en: Communication port on one unit faulty.
causes.ur: Ek unit ka communication port kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power down the units and isolate AC input before touching the communication wiring.
solutions.ur: Communication wiring chhoone se pehle units band kar dein aur AC input alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the CAN cable at both ends — fully plugged in, with no broken pins or cuts.
solutions.ur: CAN cable ke dono taraf check karein — pura laga hua hai, tooti hui pins ya kata hua jagah to nahin.

solutions.en: Swap with a known-good cable and restart; if the code remains, contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Kisi known-good cable se badal kar restart karein; code bana rahe to installer se rabta karein.

title.ur: Host unit ka data gayab hona

meaning.en: Parallel host (master) communication lost.
meaning.ur: Master (host) se communication ka rabta toot gaya.

causes.en: Master offline or cable fault
causes.ur: master off line ya cable

causes.en: Host unit tripped or switched off.
causes.ur: Host unit trip ho gaya ya band kar diya gaya.

causes.en: Cable between the host and the other units damaged.
causes.ur: Host aur baqi units ke darmiyan cable kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check the host unit is powered on and not tripped, then isolate supplies before checking wiring.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke host unit on hai ya trip to nahi, phir wiring check karne se pehle supplies alag karein.

solutions.en: Check the communication cable between host and other units for looseness or damage and re-seat it.
solutions.ur: Host aur doosri units ke darmiyan communication cable check karein aur dobara theek se laga dein.

solutions.en: Restart the system; if the host is still not detected, contact the installer.
solutions.ur: System restart karein; phir bhi host detect na ho to installer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Parallel units out of sync (e.g., AC input breakers closed at different times).
meaning.ur: Parallel units sync mein nahi hain (misal ke tor par AC input breakers alag-alag waqt par band kiye gaye).

causes.en: Staggered AC input energization
causes.ur: AC input alag alag

causes.en: AC input breakers closed at different times.
causes.ur: AC input breakers alag alag waqt par band kiye gaye.

causes.en: Mains phase shifted during the start.
causes.ur: Start ke dauran mains phase badal gaya.

solutions.en: Shut down the units and isolate AC input before checking the parallel setup.
solutions.ur: Parallel setup check karne se pehle units band kar dein aur AC input alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Switch on the AC input breakers of all units at the same time and check the mains wiring between them.
solutions.ur: Sab units ke AC input breakers ek sath on karein aur un ke darmiyan mains wiring check karein.

solutions.en: If the units still lose sync after a simultaneous start, contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Ek sath start karne ke baad bhi units ka sync toota rahe to installer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Commissioning note: fault 82 on following-order inverters then auto-restart.
notes.ur: Commissioning note: following-order inverters par fault 82 aata hai, phir auto-restart ho jata hai.

meaning.en: Parallel units measure different battery voltages.
meaning.ur: parallel units par battery voltage alag mili

causes.en: Different battery strings, unequal cable length/material
causes.ur: Battery strings alag, ya cable ki lambai/material barabar nahi.

causes.en: Different battery types or charge levels in the bank.
causes.ur: Bank mein alag battery types ya charge levels hain.

causes.en: Long or thin battery cable causing voltage drop.
causes.ur: Lambi ya patli battery cable voltage drop de rahi hai.

solutions.en: Isolate supplies and measure the battery voltage at each unit DC input with the same meter.
solutions.ur: Supplies alag kar ke ek hi meter se har unit ke DC input par battery voltage naapein.

solutions.en: Check that all units share one battery bank with equal cable length and size; fix loose or thin cables.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sab units ek hi battery bank share karte hain aur cables barabar lambai/motai ki hain; dheeli ya patli cables theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the readings match; if they still differ, contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Restart kar ke tasdeeq karein ke readings barabar hain; phir bhi farq ho to installer se rabta karein.

title.en: AC input voltage and frequency detected different
title.ur: AC input voltage aur frequency alag detect hui

meaning.en: Parallel units see different utility voltage/frequency timing.
meaning.ur: parallel units par utility alag mili

causes.en: Different utility start times, breakers not simultaneous
causes.ur: utility alag alag on

causes.en: Input breakers not switched on together.
causes.ur: Input breakers ek sath on nahin kiye gaye.

causes.en: Loose mains terminal on one unit.
causes.ur: Ek unit par mains terminal dheela hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and check the mains wiring to each unit for loose terminals.
solutions.ur: AC input alag kar ke har unit tak jane wali mains wiring ke dheele terminals check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the mains voltage at each unit input and compare the readings.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke input par mains voltage naapein aur readings compare karein.

solutions.en: Switch all AC input breakers on together, restart, and contact the installer if the code remains.
solutions.ur: Sab AC input breakers ek sath on karein, restart karein, aur code bana rahe to installer se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Parallel units share load unequally.
meaning.ur: Parallel units par load barabar nahi banta.

causes.en: Excess load, unequal AC cable length/material
causes.ur: Load zyada, ya AC cable ki lambai/material barabar nahi.

causes.en: Load concentrated on one unit.
causes.ur: Load ek unit par jama ho gaya.

causes.en: AC input/output cable size not equal.
causes.ur: AC input/output cable ka size barabar nahin hai.

solutions.en: Isolate supplies and check how the load is shared across units and phases.
solutions.ur: Supplies alag kar ke check karein ke load units aur phases mein kis tarah banta hua hai.

solutions.en: Move some loads so each unit carries a similar share and check AC cable length and type are equal.
solutions.ur: Kuch loads shift kar ke har unit ka hissa milta julta karein aur check karein ke AC cables barabar lambai/type ki hain.

solutions.en: Restart and watch the output currents; if they stay unbalanced, contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Restart kar ke output currents dekhein; unbalance bana rahe to installer se rabta karein.

title.en: AC output mode setting is different

meaning.en: Program 28 AC output mode not identical across parallel units.
meaning.ur: program 28 (AC output mode) sb units par alag hai

causes.en: Different program 28 settings (PAL / 3P1 / 3P2 / 3P3)
causes.ur: Program 28 ki setting alag (PAL / 3P1 / 3P2 / 3P3)

causes.en: One unit left on a different output program.
causes.ur: Ek unit alag output program par chhodi gayi hai.

causes.en: Settings changed after service on some units.
causes.ur: Kuch units ki service ke baad settings badal di gayin.

solutions.en: Power off the units and open the AC output mode (program 28) menu on each unit.
solutions.ur: Units band kar dein aur har unit mein AC output mode (program 28) menu kholein.

solutions.en: Set the same output mode on all units (PAL / 3P1 / 3P2 / 3P3 as used).
solutions.ur: Sab units par ek hi output mode set karein (PAL / 3P1 / 3P2 / 3P3 jo use ho raha hai).

solutions.en: Power up together and confirm the code clears; if it returns, contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Ek sath power on karein aur code ke hatne ka tasdeeq karein; wapas aaye to installer se rabta karein.

title.en: BMS: charge and discharge stopped by battery
title.ur: Battery ne charge/discharge band kar diya

meaning.en: After successful battery comms, battery status forbids charge+discharge, shown as code 60.
meaning.ur: battery communication ke baad battery charge/discharge ki ijazat nahin de rahi code 60

causes.en: Lithium BMS protective trip (over-voltage, under-voltage, temp, etc.)
causes.ur: Lithium BMS ka protective trip (over-voltage, under-voltage, temperature wagaira).

causes.en: Battery cell over-voltage or under-voltage recorded by the BMS.
causes.ur: BMS ne cell over-voltage ya under-voltage record kiya hai.

causes.en: Battery temperature out of the allowed range.
causes.ur: Battery temperature allowed range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Check the BMS alarm or log on the battery to see which protection tripped.
solutions.ur: Battery ke BMS alarm ya log check karein ke kaunsi protection trip hui hai.

solutions.en: Clear the battery fault or let the battery recover, then check whether charging and discharging are allowed again.
solutions.ur: Battery fault clear karein ya battery ko theek hone dein, phir check karein ke charge/discharge dobara ijazat mil gayi hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: If the battery still forbids operation, consult the battery maker before re-energising the system.
solutions.ur: Agar battery phir bhi operation ki ijazat na de, to system ko dobara power dene se pehle battery maker se rai lein.

notes.en: Same numeric id as parallel fault 60 (power feedback) - dual meaning depends on feature. BMS Code Reference context (collides with parallel fault number).
notes.ur: Parallel fault 60 (power feedback) ka wohi numeric id hai - feature ke hisab se dual meaning badalta hai. BMS Code Reference ka context hai (yeh parallel fault number se murtabta hai).

meaning.en: Battery forbids charging, shown as code 69.
meaning.ur: battery charge ki ijazat nahin de rahi code 69

causes.en: BMS charge inhibit (full, cold, cell imbalance)
causes.ur: BMS charge rok

causes.en: Battery already full or nearly full.
causes.ur: Battery pehle se full ya nearly full hai.

causes.en: Battery too cold for charging.
causes.ur: Battery charge ke liye bohat thandi hai.

solutions.en: Check the BMS status on the battery — full, too cold or a cell imbalance usually inhibits charging.
solutions.ur: Battery par BMS status check karein — full hona, sardi ya cell imbalance charging rok deta hai.

solutions.en: Let the battery warm up or discharge a little, then check whether charging starts again.
solutions.ur: Battery ko garam hone dein ya thoda discharge karein, phir check karein ke charging dobara shuru hoti hai ya nahin.

solutions.en: Discharge may continue until the alarm clears; if it stays, contact the battery maker.
solutions.ur: Alarm hatne tak discharge chalta reh sakta hai; agar woh ruka rahe to battery maker se rabta karein.

title.ur: BMS: charge karo (battery ko charge zaroori)

meaning.en: Battery status requires charging; code 70 shown while charging per BMS.
meaning.ur: battery kahe rahi hai charge zaroori hai code 70

causes.en: Normal BMS-driven charge request
causes.ur: Aam BMS se chalne wali charge request.

solutions.en: Informational; ensure charger/PV source available
solutions.ur: Maloomati baat — charger/PV source mojood ho, iska intezam rakhein.

notes.en: Documented as status code not failure.
notes.ur: Isay status code ke tor par document kiya gaya hai, failure nahin.

meaning.en: Battery forbids discharge, shown as code 71.
meaning.ur: battery discharge ki ijazat nahin de rahi code 71

causes.en: BMS discharge inhibit (SOC low, temp, fault)
causes.ur: BMS discharge rok

causes.en: Battery state of charge too low to allow discharge.
causes.ur: Battery ka discharge hone layaq charge bohat kam hai.

causes.en: Battery cell fault recorded by the BMS.
causes.ur: BMS ne battery cell fault record kiya hai.

solutions.en: Check the BMS status — low state of charge, temperature limit or a cell fault usually blocks discharge.
solutions.ur: BMS status check karein — kam charge, temperature limit ya cell fault discharge rok deta hai.

solutions.en: Charge the battery or correct the temperature or fault condition and check whether the load can be supplied again.
solutions.ur: Battery charge karein ya temperature/fault theek karein, phir check karein ke load dobara supply ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: The load will be lost while discharge is forbidden; if it stays, contact the battery maker.
solutions.ur: Discharge band rehne tak load chala jayega; woh bana rahe to battery maker se rabta karein.

notes.en: Same numeric id as parallel fault 71 (firmware mismatch) - dual meaning. BMS Code Reference context (collides with parallel fault number).
notes.ur: Parallel fault 71 (firmware mismatch) ka wohi numeric id hai - dual meaning. BMS Code Reference ka context hai (yeh parallel fault number se murtabta hai).

title.en: Un-identified unit for master or slave
title.ur: Master/slave ke liye unit ki identification nahi hui.

meaning.en: Unit role not yet assigned in parallel setup.
meaning.ur: Parallel setup mein unit ka role abhi tak set nahin kiya gaya.

causes.en: Parallel commissioning incomplete
causes.ur: Parallel commissioning adhoori hai.

solutions.en: Follow parallel commissioning steps (program 28, share cables)
solutions.ur: Parallel commissioning ke steps follow karein (program 28, share cables).

notes.en: Code Reference table with HS/SL.
notes.ur: HS/SL ke sath Code Reference table.

meaning.en: This unit is parallel master (randomly assigned at power-up).
meaning.ur: yeh unit parallel master hai

causes.en: Normal parallel role display
causes.ur: Aam parallel role display

solutions.en: None; informational
solutions.ur: koi kaam nahin

meaning.en: This unit is parallel slave.
meaning.ur: yeh unit parallel slave hai

causes.en: Normal parallel role display
causes.ur: Aam parallel role display

solutions.en: None; informational
solutions.ur: koi kaam nahin

meaning.en: Cooling fan is locked while inverter is on.
meaning.ur: inverter chal rahe huey Pankha band hai

causes.en: Fan obstructed or failed
causes.ur: Pankha ruka ya kharab

solutions.en: Check airflow; replace fan if stuck
solutions.ur: hawa ka rasta check karein Pankha atka ho to tabdeeli karein

notes.en: Warning table p.35. Same numeric id as fault 01; display context differs. Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Warning table p.35 par hai. Fault 01 ka wohi numeric id hai; display context alag hai. Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

meaning.en: Internal temperature high enough to warn, not yet full fault shutdown.
meaning.ur: Andaruni temperature itni zyada ho gayi hai ke warning aa jaye, abhi tak full fault shutdown nahi hua.

causes.en: Blocked vents, high ambient temp, heavy load, dust (anti-dust kit dirty)
causes.ur: Hawa ke raste band, mahol ki temperature zyada, bhari load, dust (anti-dust kit gandi).

solutions.en: Improve ventilation, clean filter foam monthly, reduce load
solutions.ur: Hawa ka rasta behtar karein, filter foam mahine mein saaf karein, load kam karein.

notes.en: Escalates to fault 02 when component >100C. Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Component 100C se zyada hone par fault 02 par escalate hota hai. Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

meaning.en: Battery voltage reached over-charge level.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage over-charge level tak pahunch gaya.

causes.en: Wrong charge settings, wrong battery type/quantity, faulty battery
causes.ur: ghalat charge setting ya battery

solutions.en: Verify battery spec/quantity and charge voltage settings
solutions.ur: battery specification aur charge setting check karein

notes.en: Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

meaning.en: Battery voltage below low-DC warning threshold; output may be cut.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage low-DC warning threshold se neeche; output band ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Discharged battery, weak cells, long battery cables
causes.ur: battery khaali ya kamzor

solutions.en: Recharge or replace battery; check connections
solutions.ur: battery charge ya tabdeeli karein connection check karein

notes.en: SIMREX fault table has no fault 04 (04 is warning-only here; SIMRON has fault 04). Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: SIMREX fault table mein fault 04 nahin hai (yahan 04 sirf warning hai; SIMRON mein fault 04 hai). Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

meaning.en: Load approaching/exceeding limit; derating or pre-shutdown warning.
meaning.ur: Load had ke qareeb ya us se zyada; derating ya band hone se pehle ki warning.

causes.en: Load > inverter rating
causes.ur: Load inverter rating se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Reduce load (switch off non-critical equipment)
solutions.ur: Load kam karein (gair zaroori aalat band kar ke).

notes.en: Fault 07 = overload 110% and time is up. Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Fault 07 = overload 110% aur time khatam. Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

meaning.en: Inverter reducing output power (thermal or overload derating).
meaning.ur: Inverter output power kam kar raha hai (thermal ya overload derating).

causes.en: High temperature or sustained overload
causes.ur: zyada hararat ya load

solutions.en: Reduce load / improve cooling; service if persists
solutions.ur: load kam karein ya thandak barhayein

notes.en: Distinct from fault 10 (PV current over / troubleshooting Surge). Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Fault 10 (PV current over / troubleshooting Surge) se alag hai. Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

meaning.en: Battery path not detected (warning code bP).
meaning.ur: battery connection nahin mila

causes.en: Battery disconnected, blown fuse, loose cable, reverse polarity
causes.ur: Battery nikalna, fuse uda hua, loose cable ya polarity ulti

solutions.en: Check battery wiring and fuses
solutions.ur: battery wiring aur fuse check karein

notes.en: Alphanumeric warning id; not on SIMRON. Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Yeh alphanumeric warning id hai; SIMRON par nahin hai. Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

meaning.en: Communication failure between com. port and control board / display panel.
meaning.ur: Com. port aur control board / display panel ke darmiyan communication ki failure.

causes.en: Display/communication cable loose or damaged
causes.ur: display cable damage

solutions.en: Reseat communication cable; service if persists
solutions.ur: cable dobaara lagayein

notes.en: SIMRON wording: between inverter and display panel. Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: SIMRON wording: inverter aur display panel ke darmiyan. Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.
